ocean.math: Browser float libm and reciprocal square root; original captured arithmetic verified independently

water.scope: Original 96x96 Ocean projected sphere grid under the shared SetOceanRender state, Plane10x10 local Water transforms and original Ocean/OceanMesh variants; WaterSim/Reset two-target GLSL with GPU history and restored material wind scroll. The water opaque sampler maps viewport zero sky depth to the equivalent 256000m far distance; actual surface depth is unchanged. Browser Ocean math, editor camera grid focus, zero Avatar contact impulses, sky-only probe and empty point-light grid are explicit adapters. Wet variants bind the PuddleSim signed zero-gradient reset. Actual PuddleSim/rain drops, scene reflections, complete Ocean lifecycle and Metal image parity remain pending
